items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And so when I got there for the second Benny Carter band, he was out of jail.

ctx.x: Yeah. And so when I got there for the second Benny Carter band, he was out of jail. So the hotel served a very short notice on Benny Carter and told him that they were going to pay him two weeks' money in order for Les Brown to come in, the main dining room. So Benny didn't give them any lip or anything. He packed up, bag and baggage, and told the band that that was their last night. And they gave him half of the money and told him to come back the next week and they'd give him the other half, you know, for the…
